summary: Melbourne, Australia, software engineer, extensive experience in technical interviews, strong background in programming languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust), expertise in operational transformation (OT) and conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs), interest in real-time collaborative editing systems, advocate for open-source software, critical of current software development practices, engaged in discussions about social and political issues, values transparency and accountability in technology, enjoys fitness activities like Ring Fit Adventures, has a preference for remote work environments, and emphasizes the importance of mentorship and responsibility in engineering roles.
